issues.description: push_error is called with a string but likely expects an ErrorFrame object
issues.detail: Previously push_error was called as `push_error(error_msg=...)`. If push_error signature expects an ErrorFrame (as is standard in pipecat services), this was likely already a latent bug, but expanding the surface area to many more error types amplifies the issue. Verify push_error accepts string kwarg `error_msg` or wrap in ErrorFrame.

issues.description: Duplicate `transcriber_error` entry in the error message_type tuple
issues.detail: The tuple at lines ~725-740 lists `transcriber_error` twice. While harmless functionally (tuple membership), it suggests a copy-paste error and may indicate a different intended message_type was omitted (e.g. one of the ElevenLabs error codes was meant in its place).

issues.description: Removal of error logging loses visibility into specific error types
issues.detail: The previous code logged distinct messages like `ElevenLabs auth error:` and `ElevenLabs quota exceeded:` at error level. The new unified branch only pushes the error frame without a logger.error call, reducing observability. Operators relying on these log strings for alerting/dashboards will see regressions.

issues.description: Generic 'Error:' prefix loses semantic distinction between error categories
issues.detail: All error types now produce `Error: {error_msg}` regardless of category (auth, quota, rate_limited, etc.). Downstream consumers of error frames can no longer easily distinguish auth failures from quota issues. Consider including `message_type` in the pushed error string for triage.

issues.description: Removed warning log when WebSocket connection closes hurts debugging
issues.detail: The deleted `logger.warning(f"{self} WebSocket connection closed: {e}")` was useful diagnostic output when reconnect logic kicks in. While the fix correctly removes the swallowing try/except to allow the outer loop's reconnect path to run, consider preserving a debug/info log at the call site for visibility.

`changelog/3233.fixed.md` ends without a newline (`\ No newline at end of file`). Minor style nit but worth fixing for POSIX compliance and to avoid issues with tools that concatenate changelog fragments.

review.summary: The PR correctly addresses the infinite-loop bug by removing the inner try/except in `_receive_messages` that was swallowing websocket disconnect exceptions, allowing the outer reconnect logic to fire. The error-type expansion is well-intentioned but has issues: a duplicated `transcriber_error` entry, loss of per-error-type logging, and a generic error prefix that drops semantic context downstream. The push_error call signature should be verified against the base class. Overall a reasonable fix but needs cleanup before merge.
